# openwebui_tool_valves (Resource)

Configures the Valves (settings) of an Open WebUI tool. Valves are the tool's user-configurable parameters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openwebui_tool_valves" "example" {
  tool_id = openwebui_tool.example.id

  valves_json = jsonencode({
    max_pages = 5
    timeout   = 30
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tool_id` (String) Identifier of the tool whose valves to configure. Forces replacement.

### Optional

- `valves_json` (String) JSON object of valve values to apply. Keys must match the tool's Valves schema. e.g. `jsonencode({ max_pages = 5, timeout = 30 })`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Mirrors `tool_id`.
- `spec_json` (String) JSON schema specification of the tool's Valves class. Read-only; returned by Open WebUI.
